Temporal and text analysis

biblioIntegrator team

v06-temporal-text.Rmd

Purpose

Time and text modules provide transparent summaries without requiring Python. They can be used before more complex semantic models.

Workflow 

x <- as_biblio_project(example_biblio())
temporal_growth(x)
#>   year documents citations growth_pct
#> 1 2017         1        55         NA
#> 2 2018         1        42          0
#> 3 2019         1        35          0
#> 4 2020         2        54        100
#> 5 2021         1        31        -50
#> 6 2022         2        39        100
#> 7 2023         1        18        -50
#> 8 2024         2        26        100
#> 9 2025         1         9        -50
trend_topics(x)
#>    year          keyword n
#> 1  2022      aggregation 1

#> 4  2022      cover crops 1

Interpretation

Results should be interpreted in relation to database coverage, time window, entity normalization and analytical thresholds. Provenance should be retained whenever data are merged, deduplicated or enriched.
